name: The Lightning Quilt
prompt: Spread a patchwork of red copper and green patinated plates across a sunken yard. Researchers connect their edges with giant quilt pins. A branching white spark briefly reveals the one disconnected patch, where a crew waits with a replacement.

name: The Static Menagerie
prompt: Equip a low amber resin racetrack with soft fur brushes. Light pith animals lean and leap as visitors push charged rods toward them. The largest paper hare hovers above the track, its feet still casting separate shadows.

name: A Battery of Pickles
prompt: Set out stepped shelves of translucent lemon-coloured jars big enough to enter, linked by sagging copper strips. A single cobalt lamp shines above each active jar. Attendants exchange exhausted amber brine for green liquid with barrel carts.

name: The Bell That Transmits Light
prompt: Hang an enormous transparent bell between two squat white coils. Its vibration distorts a shaft of light into a bright ribbon across the floor. Scientists on wheeled stools catch successive shapes using squares of smoked glass.

name: The Dynamo Roundabout
prompt: Place a flat scarlet spinning disc among fixed horseshoe magnets the size of doorways. Neighbours walk around its rim pushing handrails, powering tiny illuminated workbenches cut into the stationary magnets. A child holds one newly lit paper lantern.
